turns.content: In a dynamical theory with isolated magnetic charges, identify the magnetic charge density and magnetic current required when monopoles can move.
Use the field duality implied by the source types identified above to write their modifications to Maxwell's equations and identify every divergence or curl equation that gains a new source term.
Map those modifications to named laws. In particular, explain why the current associated with moving new charges modifies Faraday's circulation law for the electric field.
Take the divergence of the generalized Faraday law and combine it with the time derivative of the corresponding Gauss law to derive continuity for the new charge.
Check from the duality and source assignments whether either of the other two Maxwell equations receives a direct term from these new sources.
Report which ordinary Maxwell equations change and the new source added to each.
